title: exudev linux: WSL is asked for the repository path through its shell, which eats the backslashes
author: Claude-JG
description: exudev linux --py 313 stopped with 'wslpath: C:DATAcppEXUDYN_git' / 'could not ask WSL for the repository path' (maintainer 2026-10-06): WslRepositoryRoot ran 'wsl wslpath -a C:\DATA\...', which current WSL (3.0) passes through the login shell; 'wsl --exec' and forward slashes fix it
releaseNotes: exudev linux works again on Windows: it asks WSL for the repository path with wsl --exec and forward slashes, which the login shell of current WSL no longer garbles (revision2026b step RG10.17)
